awarenessGaps.name: World COPD Day
awarenessGaps.owner: Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease (GOLD)
awarenessGaps.reason: The owner's page states a past year's date ('World COPD Day takes place on November 19th', 2025) and does not state the rule that sets the date. The date is widely reported as the third Wednesday of November, but GOLD's own page does not say so, and deriving it from one past date would be inference. Re-read GOLD's page once it carries the current year.

awarenessGaps.name: World Asthma Day
awarenessGaps.reason: GINA's page is stale: the only date it states is 'May 3, 2022'. World Asthma Day moves (first Tuesday of May is the commonly reported rule) but GINA's own page does not state the rule, so no date can be published from this source.

awarenessGaps.name: World Kidney Day
awarenessGaps.owner: International Society of Nephrology / World Kidney Day
awarenessGaps.reason: The owner's site blocks automated reading of the campaign page and the readable pages carry blog dates only, not the campaign date. Commonly reported as the second Thursday of March; not stated on any owner page that could be read. Needs a manual read.

awarenessGaps.name: Stoptober
awarenessGaps.owner: Office for Health Improvement and Disparities / DHSC
awarenessGaps.reason: No owner page located stating the campaign dates for the current year. Runs through October, but the owner's own statement of dates has not been read.

awarenessGaps.name: World Obesity Day
awarenessGaps.reason: The owner's page states only a date that has already passed ('World Obesity Day 2026 takes place on 4 March') and does not state whether the date is fixed or how it is set. Publishing it would put a past date on a forward calendar, so it is held until the owner states the next one. Widely reported as 4 March annually.

awarenessGaps.name: World Continence Week
awarenessGaps.owner: World Federation for Incontinence and Pelvic Problems (WFIPP); endorsed by the International Continence Society (ICS)
awarenessGaps.reason: Owner corrected from ICS to WFIPP (WFIPP devises and runs it; ICS only endorses) and WFIPP's own page confirmed as accurate: '15-21 June 2026'. But that date is now in the past and WFIPP has not yet published 2027 dates, so it cannot be published as a forward-looking entry (verify.py's annualReview check correctly refuses a stale announced occurrence). Re-check https://wfipp.org/event/ nearer June 2027 for the announced date.

awarenessGaps.name: Organ Donation Week
awarenessGaps.reason: The owner's page states only the 2026 dates ("Monday 21 to Sunday 27 September"), re-read 28/09/2026, and that week has now passed (ended 27/09/2026). No 2027 date is announced on the page and no rule for setting the date (e.g. a fixed week number) is stated, so a future occurrence cannot be published from this source. Re-read the page once NHS Blood and Transplant announce the next date.

awarenessGaps.name: Eczema Awareness Week
awarenessGaps.owner: Eczema UK (formerly the National Eczema Society)
awarenessGaps.reason: The owner's page states only the 2026 week ('Eczema Awareness Week - 12-19 September'), which has passed, and publishes no rule that sets the date. Re-read the page once Eczema UK announces 2027.

awarenessGaps.name: Sun Awareness Week
awarenessGaps.reason: BAD's own page states only 'Sun Awareness Week 2026 will be from 11 May to 17 May', which has passed. The 2027 dates circulating on awareness-day directories are not on BAD's page. Re-read once BAD announces 2027.

awarenessGaps.name: Hidradenitis Suppurativa (HS) Awareness Week
awarenessGaps.reason: No owner page states the dates. The HS Foundation's events page does not list the week, and the only dated statements found were third-party calendars and company social posts, which are not the owner.
